company.description: Crypthulhu Studios develops blockchain-based gaming studios intended for Web3 gaming. Their blockchain technology runs on Web3, allowing collaboration between developers and gamers that utilizes distributed ledger technology to offer greater transparency, security, democratization, and user control over in-game assets, offering players a longer-lasting, immersive gaming experience to play RPG games seamlessly.
